mech.about: 3D-printable enclosures fitted to KiCad boards, modelled in code.

hwde.about: KiCad PCB design from a written brief to a fab package.

chip-flow.about: Chip design with open tools: /vde, /ade and /msde skills down to a GF180 tile.
chip-flow.needs: the IIC-OSIC-TOOLS image for simulation and hardening

fw.about: ESP32 firmware: host tests, builds, QEMU boots.
fw.needs: ESP-IDF, about 2 GB, via fw setup

video.about: Demo videos and highlight reels in code: frame-exact web films, Blender 3D shots, smooth MP4 and GIF.
video.needs: node, ffmpeg; Blender only for 3D shots

autoresearch.about: A loop that optimises one metric.
